environment: Local Vite, isolated Supabase/payment browser fixtures, Chromium 390x844
scenarios: Cancellation page reads saved Russian/English titles, messages and return/home button text
Success preview saves independent locale keys and retains both versions through reload
Cancellation preview edits the same localized message that the public page reads
Switching language while an inline draft is open cannot write that draft into the other language
Real pending/failure screens read localized processing and payment_error keys
Fixed verification safety advice remains visible independently of custom copy
Payment preview headings no longer contain block editor containers or incorporate the edit button into their heading name
Compact language buttons expose names containing visible RU/EN and their full language names
copy_compatibility: Canonical keys already exist in the seeded/public home_content schema. Shared unsuffixed historical keys are retained as data but cannot override per-language pages; no database migration or automatic content rewrite was performed.
limitations: No production frontend publication or real Stripe/Resend round trip. Source question language and legacy cognitive/archetype claims remain separate audit work.
